final: WITH matched AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.recordvault, o.dealedge FROM riskandmargin rm INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault), side_counts AS (SELECT dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) as cnt FROM matched GROUP BY dealedge), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_above_avg, AVG(cnt - (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_count)) as avg_excess FROM side_counts WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_count)    -- returns: (521, 21.5)
